Specification: This module is a small test specification for the standard FiniteSets module. It declares a single variable x, initializes it to 0, and defines a stuttering Next action that keeps x unchanged. The main operator Inv is a state-level conjunction of four IF-THEN-ELSE checks that test IsFiniteSet and Cardinality on the empty set and on the finite set {"a", "b"}, using TLC's Print and Assert operators to report success or failure.
IfThenElse: IF IsFiniteSet({"a", "b"}) THEN Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
IF IsFiniteSet({}) THEN Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed")
IF Cardinality({}) = 0 THEN Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 Failed")
IF Cardinality({"a", "b"}) = 2 THEN Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 Failed")
